skill.displayName: Qordinate - Durable lists, facts, and reminders for OpenClaw agents.
skill.summary: Qordinate is a chat-native assistant that acts as structured memory for your agents. Use this skill when you want your OpenClaw agent to offload long-term facts, tasks, and reminders into Qordinate over WhatsApp, Telegram, or Slack instead of managing its own database.
